genomes.name: Quieter Trend + Z-Dip
genomes.thesis: A cleaner, quieter version of the leader. Long above the 50-day mean while 20-day volatility is under 22%, after a 1.35-sigma dip above the 200-day, or on a close back over the 50-day. Out when volatility passes 50% or on a close under the 50-day that is not oversold; 4.2% stop, 7% target, 5% trailing stop, 13 sessions, two-session wait.
genomes.rationale: Written by Claude in round three, injected into the trend-plus-dip island at generation 15, and scored exactly as written.
